notes.title: First Strike 7 Year Anniversary Remaster Update
notes.notes:
Hello all fans of Blindflug Studios

First Strike, the nuclear war game, which was also the game that founded our studio, will have a major milestone this week: It is turning seven years old!

To celebrate, we gave it a special treatment as a game: it got a complete remaster. The new First Strike is faster, sleeker and more cunning, but still has the old bombastic gameplay that made it such a hit for us.

Check it out, we also have a nice discount going for its celebration as well as a livestream on Saturday 13th of March on 7PM CET.

Check out First Strike: Classic

So Happy Birthday First Strike! Never stop nuking the world!

notes.title: Celebrating the AIRHEART physical release - Cloud Chasers gets a 40% discount!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32159880/6dc50f5a48391d2ff8d0b972c4a011890f402682.jpg

It's something we always dreamed of, and today it will happen: our first physical release! AIRHEART, the sequel to Cloud Chasers, will get a disc version for PlayStation 4, published by Limited Run Games. Make sure to check out the LRG store[www.limitedrungames.com] today to order your copy, it's limited to 1500 prints!

When starting working on Cloud Chasers we would have never thought that Amelia will some day be on the cover of a real physical copy. But today is the day!ːsteamhappyː

We're extremely happy, and to celebrate the occasion we discounted the Steam versions of Cloud Chasers for 40% and First Strike: Final Hour for 60%.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32159880/064257497201bd99da40ad342acbefe59d49d2b0.jpg

As for the Airheart disc release: every copy comes with a poster and a reversible cover (as well as a special LRG skin for an airplane), and there's also a bundle where you get the original Airheart soundtrack. We love the music that Michel Barengo (also composer of the Cloud Chasers soundtrack) creates, so we'd go for that version ;). 


Thanks for playing Cloud Chasers (and hopefully) Airheart!

Your Blindflug Studios Team
